sample_unit: FAQ prompts (ChatGPT-4o responses rated by 5 endocrinologists)

links.outcome: Readability (FRES, FKGL) of ChatGPT-4o diabetes education responses versus sixth-grade benchmark
links.effect: Mean FRES 38.19 and mean FKGL 16.87, college-level and substantially above the recommended sixth-grade benchmark for patient health materials.
links.quote: The mean FRES was 38.19 and the mean FKGL was 16.87, indicating a reading level appropriate for college-educated individuals and substantially above the recommended sixth-grade benchmark for patient health materials.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated patient education content
links.effect: Mean FKGL 16.87 and FRES 38.19; raters concerned linguistic complexity may impede comprehension among patients with limited health literacy.
links.quote: Raters expressed concern about linguistic complexity, which may impede comprehension among patients with limited health literacy.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-4o responses to common diabetes education questions, rated by endocrinologists and evaluated for readability, without testing a specific deployment intervention or safeguard.
